blocks.text: Biodiversity ki jaanch (assessment) kai levels par hoti hai, aur har level zindagi ki complexity ke bare mein apni alag maloomat deta hai.

Species level: is level par kisi ilaqe mein maujood mukhtalif species ko pehchaan kar aur gin kar biodiversity jaanchi jati hai. Species diversity mein sirf species ki tadaad nahi, balke har species ke afraad ki nisbati tadaad (relative abundance) aur un ka phailao (distribution) bhi shamil hai.

Genetic level: is level par biodiversity ka matlab hai ek species ke tamam afraad mein maujood genetic maloomat ki variety. Yeh genetic diversity species ke adapt hone (dhalne) aur zinda rehne ke liye bohat zaroori hai, kyunke isi se species mahol ki tabdeeliyon aur mushkilon ka saamna kar paati hai.

Ecosystem level: is level par jaanch mein habitats ki poori range aati hai: jungle (forests) aur daldali ilaqe (wetlands) se le kar ghaas ke maidan (grasslands) aur registan (deserts) tak. Is mein yeh samajhna shamil hai ke mukhtalif ecosystems kaise kaam karte hain aur poore mahol ki sehat (ecological health) mein kya hissa daalte hain.
